shadows.name: workspace-lift

motion.name: trace-draw
motion.purpose: Redraws trajectory traces on initial entry and discrete scenario changes.

motion.name: plot-sweep

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively disables transitions and animations for reduced-motion users.

components.name: Reset Button
components.description: Quiet utility action for restoring calculator defaults.
components.css: .ds-reset-button { min-width: 54px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #86919a; border-radius: 3px; color: #101b2b; background: transparent; font: 500 0.75rem Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-reset-button:hover { background: #fbfcfb; } .ds-reset-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36,91,150,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Scenario
components.description: Two-line scenario row with a visible selected state.
components.css: .ds-scenario { display: block; color: #101b2b; cursor: pointer; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-scenario input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-scenario span { min-height: 53px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 88px 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #86919a; border-radius: 4px; background: #fbfcfb; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(25,39,50,.07); } .ds-scenario strong { font-size: .83rem; } .ds-scenario small { color: #556070; font-size: .74rem; } .ds-scenario:hover span { background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); } .ds-scenario input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid rgba(36,91,150,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cobalt Range Control
components.description: Direct-manipulation assumption control with a telemetry value.
components.css: .ds-range { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px 16px; color: #101b2b; font: 600 .85rem Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-range output { color: #245b96; font: 700 .7rem ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .055em; } .ds-range input { grid-column: 1 / -1; width: 100%; accent-color: #245b96; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36,91,150,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Shell
components.description: Unified control-rack and results apparatus with a clipped case corner.
components.css: .ds-workspace { min-height: 180px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 35% 1fr; border: 1px solid #86919a; background: #fbfcfb; box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(25,39,50,.09); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 22px) 0, 100% 22px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); color: #101b2b; font: 600 1rem Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-workspace aside { padding: 28px 26px; background: #e9edef; border-right: 1px solid #86919a; } .ds-workspace main { padding: 28px; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-workspace { grid-template-columns: 1fr; clip-path: none; } .ds-workspace aside { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #86919a; } }

narrative.overview:
Opportunity FLOPs is an analytically serious instrument workspace: cool-white equipment surfaces, midnight ink, fine plot rules, and calibrated accent traces keep assumptions and outputs in one continuous field. The composition should feel operated rather than browsed—dense enough for research, but quiet enough that state changes and caveats remain legible.

The visual hierarchy comes from typography, dividers, tonal surfaces, and synchronized plot motion. Decoration is subordinate to evidence; every bright color or animated sweep should carry status, comparison, or interaction meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous rack-and-results workspace rather than a card grid.
Cool-white panels with clipped equipment-case geometry and fine rules.
Cobalt controls and traces, oxidized-orange comparison strokes, and a darker orange reserved for readable text.
Synchronized chart redraw and sweep motion for authored entrances and discrete scenario changes, with immediate slider feedback and a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Trace/Text Separation Rule
rules.body: Oxidized orange draws comparison geometry; accessible orange carries text. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Color Carries State Rule
rules.body: Accent color indicates scenario, status, or direct manipulation; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for values, legends, status, and axis metadata; narrative remains in Barlow.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Elevate the calculator as one apparatus; do not turn its internal rack, charts, or comparison cells into floating cards.

dos: Do keep assumptions, plots, statuses, and caveats in one continuous analytical workspace.
Do preserve the orange text/chart-stroke distinction and label illustrative geometry explicitly.
Do reserve synchronized trace and sweep animation for initial entry and discrete scenario changes; keep continuous slider feedback immediate and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do use rules, typography, and tonal changes before adding elevation.
donts: Don't split the calculator into a grid of individually elevated cards.
Don't use accent color as decoration or rely on color alone to communicate state.
Don't introduce playful mascot, flip-flop, or character illustration into the instrument world.
Don't present illustrative chart geometry as validated output or empirical results.
